description: Crowd photograph taken from within the stands at what appears to be a Trump campaign rally. Several attendees in the middle rows wear white, red, and black T-shirts bearing a large letter Q, surrounded by supporters in red MAGA-style caps; a pink Women for Trump sign is partially visible at upper right. Individuals are unidentified members of the public.
flags: Rally location and date not shown in the image
Crowd members are private individuals and remain unidentified

description: Group photograph of six unidentified rally attendees, including children, posing in the stands at Scheels Arena (signage visible), consistent with the June 2018 Trump rally in Fargo, North Dakota. All six wear shirts hand-drawn or printed with the letter Q; one adult wears a chef-style hat reading QANON and a shirt with a Punisher-skull Q graphic reading NO DEALS PAIN COMING #THEGREATAWAKENING; a boy wears a MAGA cap and a flame-styled Q THE STORM shirt. The crowd behind fills the arena bowl.
text: SCHEELS arena. USA. Q. QANON. NO DEALS. PAIN COMING. Q. #THEGREATAWAKENING. MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN. MAGA. THE Q STORM.
flags: Subjects are private individuals, including minors, and remain unidentified
Fargo location inferred from Scheels Arena signage; date not shown

description: Screenshot of a tweet dated 24 Aug 2013 from an account named Jarrod W. Ramos (@EricHartleyFrnd). The account name matches Jarrod Ramos, later charged in the June 2018 Capital Gazette newsroom shooting in Annapolis, Maryland; the tweet complains about a Google auto-suggestion of his name and disparages counseling. The handle references Eric Hartley, a former Capital Gazette columnist Ramos had feuded with.
text: Jarrod W. Ramos @EricHartleyFrnd · 24 Aug 2013. New Google auto-suggestion: "Jarrod Ramos Hartley." My therapist told me people don't search that. Counseling—much like small talk—bullshit.
flags: Attribution rests on the account name/handle; account authenticity not independently verifiable from the image

description: Screenshot of a webpage section titled Brand of Sacrifice, showing a glowing red rune-like sigil on skin — the Brand of Sacrifice symbol from Kentaro Miura's manga/anime series Berserk — above an italicized quote describing those marked by the Brand feeding life to a new Child of Darkness. The content is fictional lore from the Berserk franchise.
text: Brand of Sacrifice. You have now been marked with the Brand of Sacrifice. The lives of those who bear the Brand, from the last drop of blood, to the last moment of your agonizing death, will feed life to the new Child of Darkness.
flags: Symbol and quote are fiction from the Berserk franchise; relevance to the referencing post is interpretive
